exposure: Delivery room management (DR) of the newly born infant
finding: Side positioning during delivery room management was feasible, seemed to be associated with reduced agitation and improved oxygenation in term infants, but further research is needed to confirm a causal relationship.
mod_finding: While delivery room management was feasible in the side position for term infants, potentially with reduced agitation and improved oxygenation, this study did not compare outcomes to infants placed in the supine position.
